Over the Edge

Every team that answers right wins a counter to drop down a lane. Push the pile over the edge, then play for the jackpot together.

Outpace

The whole class is one runner. Pick a deal, then answer your way home before the Hunter catches you.

Category Clash

Teams take turns to pick a category and a points value, and every team answers. Harder questions are worth more.

Hex Hunt

Two halves of the class race to build a path across the hexagon board. Each letter is the first letter of the answer.

How to play
Every team answers every question on whiteboards, and every correct team wins a counter. Each team's captain picks a lane from 1 to 4 and the counters drop together, bouncing through the pegs onto the moving top shelf. Every counter pushed over the front edge wins £100 for the team whose counter last landed in that quarter of the shelf; counters that fall off the sides are lost. Look out for the star wildcard counters. In the final the whole class plays together: every correct team wins two counters, and pushing the gold jackpot counter over the edge adds £5,000.

Team rule: a team is correct only if its whiteboards agree on a correct answer, or if you judge it correct.

▼ HUNTER
⚑ HOME

Answer right to edge home. Answer wrong and the Hunter closes in.

How to play
The whole class is one runner against the Hunter, and every team answers every question on whiteboards.
Deal Round: vote for a deal with 1, 2 or 3 fingers. A bigger deal gives the Hunter a shorter gap. If at least half the teams are right the runner steps forward; otherwise the Hunter gains. Reach home to bank the points; if you are caught you bank half.
Final Sprint: 60 seconds. Every correct team adds a step. Reach the target to escape with the pot.

Team rule: a team is correct only if its whiteboards agree on a correct answer, or if you judge it correct.

Final Sprint
1:00
How to play
Teams take turns to choose a category and a points value, and every team answers on mini whiteboards. The choosing team wins full points if correct; every other correct team wins half. Wrong answers lose nothing. Harder questions are worth more, and one hidden ★ tile is worth double. The captain changes every turn. The team with the most points when the board is clear wins.

Team rule: a team is correct only if its whiteboards agree on a correct answer, or if you judge it correct.

★ Double points!
How to play
Split the class into two halves (each can be several table groups). Team 1 links the left edge to the right edge; Team 2 links the top to the bottom. The choosing half picks a hexagon: its letter is the first letter of the answer. Everyone answers on whiteboards. Enter roughly what share of each half got it right; the higher share wins the hexagon and picks the next one, and on a tie the half that chose it wins. The first half to join its two edges wins.

Team rule: a group counts as correct only if its whiteboards agree on a correct answer, or if you judge it correct.

Question bank

Add a question set

Subject: Chemistry Topic: Bonding Q: What type of bonding is in sodium chloride? A: Ionic

Subject and Topic lines apply to every question under them until the next Topic line. Each Q: line needs an A: line straight after it. Optional: a line such as Difficulty: 3 (1 easy to 5 hard) applies to the questions below it until the next Difficulty or Topic line. Category Clash puts level 1 questions on the 100 row, level 3 on the 200 row and level 5 on the 300 row, borrowing the nearest level when a row runs short. The other games ignore it, and sets without it still work.

About

Showtime: Classroom Gameshows, first edition, version .

Four revision games for the classroom, inspired by classic TV quiz formats: Over the Edge, Outpace, Category Clash and Hex Hunt. Game design and question packs by Rob Pearce.

The GCSE Combined Science starter packs are AQA-style practice questions written for Showtime. They are not produced or endorsed by AQA.

Privacy

Showtime makes no network connections. Question sets, team names, wrong-answer history and settings are saved only in this browser on this computer (localStorage). Use the backup in the Question bank to move them, and clear a team's history there at any time.
